<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The live route and download share the original self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "cirro.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

button:hover{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--ink)}.lab-run{width:100%;margin-top:30px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:17px 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;text-align:left}.lab-run:hover{background:#e5ff9f}.lab-screen{padding:29px 32px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 7;fill:none;opacity:.7}.chart-scenario{stroke:var(--lime);stroke-width:3;fill:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #d3ff6170)}.chart-fill{fill:url(#chartGradient)}.lab-chart-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:#8fa996;font:10px/1.5 var(--mono);margin-top:15px}.lab-legal{margin:16px 0 /* Approach */

/* Contact */
.contact{min-height:780px;min-height:100svh;background:#07130d;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}.contact:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#04110cda 0%,#04110c75 65%,#04110c7b),linear-gradient(0deg,#04110c9a,transparent 65%);z-index:-2}.contact-in{width:min(100% - 9vw,1530px);margin:auto;padding:130px 0;position:relative;z-index:2}.contact h2{font-size:clamp(67px,10vw,161px);letter-spacing:-.105em;line-height:.93;margin:44px 0 44px;max-width:1200px}.contact h2 em{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;color:var(--lime)}.contact-lower{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:45px}.contact-lower p{max-width:400px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;color:#c0d3c5}.contact-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:23px;appearance:none;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lime);cursor:pointer;font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.04em;padding:14px 0;transition:color .25s}.contact-cta:hover{color:var(--lime)}.contact-cta span:last-child{color:var(--lime)}.contact .footer-image{object-position:center}.contact .signal-webgl{opacity:.15}

dialog{border:0;padding:0;max-width:min(820px,calc(100vw - 34px));width:100%;max-height:min(92vh,920px);color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 28px 100px #0009}dialog::backdrop{background:#07120be0;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.case-modal-top{padding:26px 34px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #cdd7cd}.case-modal-top button{border:1px solid #a9b8a8;background:none;border-radius:50%;width:40px;height:40px}.case-modal-art{height:min(32vh,320px);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:clamp(65px,13vw,155px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.1em}.case-modal-body{padding:38px 34px 45px}.case-modal-body h3{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,65px);letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:0 0 17px}.case-modal-body p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;max-width:630px}.case-modal-body .disclaimer{font:11px/1.6 var(--mono);color:#54705b;margin-top:28px}.brief-dialog{padding:37px 40px;background:var(--paper)}.brief-dialog h2{font-size:clamp(33px,5vw,64px);letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:1;margin:0 0 15px}.brief-dialog p{font:14px/1.6 var(--sans);color:#476251;max-width:540px}.brief-form{margin-top:25px;display:grid;gap:14px}.brief-form label{font:700 11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.brief-form input,.brief-form textarea{border:1px solid #aabbad;color:#0b2116;background:#fff;padding:14px;font:15px var(--sans);min-width:0}.brief-form textarea{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}.brief-form button{border:0;background:var(--forest);color:white;padding:17px 22px;text-align:left;font:700 11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em}.brief-ack{background:#dbe8d7;border:1px solid #8aac8b;padding:18px;color:#153724;display:none}.brief-ack.show{display:block}

function onScroll(){if(!scrollRaf)scrollRaf=requestAnimationFrame(scrollFrame);}addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',onScroll,{passive:true});

addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&mobile.classList.contains('open'))setMobile(false);});

/* Campaign gallery: vertically driven pinning on desktop, touch scroll on mobile. */

function updateWork(){if(innerWidth<=900){workTrack.style.transform='none';return;}const rect=workSection.getBoundingClientRect();const available=Math.max(1,rect.height-innerHeight);const p=clamp(-rect.top/available);const distance=Math.max(0,workTrack.scrollWidth-innerWidth+innerWidth*.045);workTrack.style.transform=`translate3d(${-p*distance}px,0,0)`;setWorkIndex(Math.min(2,Math.floor(p*3)));}
function setWorkIndex(n){if(workIndex===n)return;workIndex=n;$('#caseNum').textContent=String(n+1).padStart(2,'0');$$('.case-dots i').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('on',i===n));}
let mobileWorkTimer;workViewport.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(innerWidth>900)return;clearTimeout(mobileWorkTimer);mobileWorkTimer=setTimeout(()=>{const cards=$$('.case-card');let best=0,bestDistance=Infinity;cards.forEach((card,i)=>{const delta=Math.abs(card.getBoundingClientRect().left+card.clientWidth/2-innerWidth/2);if(delta<bestDistance){bestDistance=delta;best=i;}});setWorkIndex(best);},50);},{passive:true});
const cases={fuse:{name:'FUSE',tag:'001 / CONSUMER LAUNCH',text:'An expressive consumer launch imagined around high-voltage creative and a visual language designed to interrupt the ordinary. The concept explores rapid visual variation across channels, from unapologetic typography to energetic graphic motion.',background:'#ffc858',color:'#17271c'},north:{name:'NORTH',tag:'002 / B2B POSITIONING',text:'An exercise in making a complex business proposition feel inevitable. Confident directional graphics, a precise visual system and a clear promise help turn complicated technology into a compelling narrative.',background:'#a5c3fc',color:'#15345a'},hush:{name:'HUSH',tag:'003 / CULTURE-LED ACTIVATION',text:'A fictional audience-first exploration built on a simple observation: standing out does not always mean shouting louder. const caseDialog=$('#caseDialog');$$('[data-case]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const c=cases[btn.dataset.case];$('#caseDialogTag').textContent=c.tag;$('#caseDialogTitle').textContent=c.name;$('#caseDialogText').textContent=c.text;const art=$('#caseDialogArt');art.textContent=c.name;art.style.background=c.background;art.style.color=c.color;openDialog(caseDialog);}));$('#closeCase').addEventListener('click',()=>caseDialog.close());caseDialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===caseDialog)caseDialog.close()});
/* Growth engine */
const stepDetails=[['Discover','FIND THE SIGNAL'],['Hypothesize','QUESTION THE OBVIOUS'],['Build','MAKE THE IDEA'],['Test','MEASURE THE RESPONSE'],['Learn','READ THE PATTERN'],['Scale','BUILD MOMENTUM']];const engineSteps=$$('[data-method]');let methodIndex=-1;
function updateMethod(){let active=0;const reference=innerHeight*.55;engineSteps.forEach((s,i)=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<=reference)active=i;});if(active===methodIndex)return;methodIndex=active;engineSteps.forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('active',i===active));$('#engineProgress').textContent=String(active+1).padStart(2,'0');$('#engineStepBig').textContent=String(active+1).padStart(2,'0');$('#engineLabel').textContent=stepDetails[active][0];$('#engineSub').textContent=stepDetails[active][1];const paths=['M63 250Q120 90 250 104T438 250','M63 250Q150 430 250 396T438 250','M63 250L180 116L320 384L438 250','M63 250C170 100 330 390 438 250','M63 250Q250 70 438 250Q250 430 63 250','M63 250C140 60 360 60 438 250S250 450 63 250'];$('#enginePath').setAttribute('d',paths[active]);}
/* Lab: a deliberately labeled hypothetical model, not a forecast. */
const range=$('#budgetRange'),budgetValue=$('#budgetValue');let creative='balanced',channel='social',variation=0;
const pick=(attr,value)=>$$(`[data-${attr}]`).forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset[attr]===value)));
$$('[data-creative]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{creative=btn.dataset.creative;pick('creative',creative);renderLab();}));$$('[data-channel]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{channel=btn.dataset.channel;pick('channel',channel);renderLab();}));range.addEventListener('input',()=>{budgetValue.textContent=`$${range.value}k`;renderLab();});$('#runTest').addEventListener('click',()=>{variation=(variation+1)%6;renderLab();$('#labStatus').textContent=`SCENARIO ${String(variation+1).padStart(2,'0')} / UPDATED`;});
function makePath(values){return values.map((y,i)=>`${i?'L':'M'}${(i/11*640).toFixed(1)} ${(258-y*2.18).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}
function renderLab(){const budget=Number(range.value),cf={efficient:-6,balanced:0,bold:9}[creative],ch={social:4,search:1,display:-3}[channel];const signal=Math.round(clamp(46+budget*.26+cf+ch+variation*.8,0,98));const lift=Math.round(8+budget*.11+cf*.45+ch*.2+variation*.4);const velocity=(3+budget*.034+(creative==='bold'?1:0)+(channel==='search'?.4:0)).toFixed(1);$('#metricSignal').textContent=signal;$('#metricLift').textContent=`+${lift}%`;$('#metricVelocity').textContent=velocity;const base=Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>30+i*2.3+Math.sin(i*1.37)*3);const scenario=Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>30+i*(1.9+budget*.034+cf*.035+ch*.03)+Math.sin(i*.93+variation*.25)*5+(creative==='bold'?Math.sin(i*2.3)*3:0));let d=makePath(scenario);$('#chartBase').setAttribute('d',makePath(base));$('#chartScenario').setAttribute('d',d);$('#chartArea').setAttribute('d',`${d} L640 280 L0 280 Z`);}
renderLab();
/* Inquiry demo — local only. */
const brief=$('#briefDialog');function openDialog(dialog){dialog.showModal();document.body.classList.add('dialog-open');}$$('dialog').forEach(d=>d.addEventListener('close',()=>document.body.classList.remove('dialog-open')));$('#openBrief').addEventListener('click',()=>openDialog(brief));$('#closeBrief').addEventListener('click',()=>brief.close());brief.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===brief)brief.close()});$('#briefForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const form=e.currentTarget;const data=new FormData(form);const name=String(data.get('name')||'').trim();const project=String(data.get('project')||'').trim();if(!name||!project){form.reportValidity();return;}const ack=$('#briefAck');ack.textContent=`Preview saved in this page for ${name}. Your project idea: “${project.slice(0,180)}${project.length>180?'…':''}”`;ack.classList.add('show');form.hidden=true;});brief.addEventListener('close',()=>{$('#briefAck').classList.remove('show');$('#briefForm').hidden=false;});
/* Hero/footer subtle shader: a light field over the user's full-bleed photography. */

<script>
/* CIRRO seamless marquee. Two identical full-width groups permit an exact
   -50% looping translation without blank space or a visible reset. */
(function () {
  const track = document.getElementById('cirroTickerTrack');
  const group = document.getElementById('cirroTickerGroup');
  if (!track || !group) return;
  const original = group.innerHTML;
  const follower = track.querySelector('.tape-group[aria-hidden="true"]');
  let prevViewport = 0, pending = 0;

  function sizeTicker(force) {
    const viewport = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    if (!force && viewport === prevViewport) return;
    prevViewport = viewport;
    track.style.animation = 'none';
    group.innerHTML = original;
    const minWidth = Math.max(1200, viewport * 1.3);
    let copies = 0;
    while (group.getBoundingClientRect().width < minWidth && copies < 20) {
      group.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', original);
      copies++;
    }
    follower.innerHTML = group.innerHTML;
    const groupWidth = group.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    track.style.setProperty('--tape-duration', (groupWidth / 65).toFixed(2) + 's');
    void track.offsetWidth;
    track.style.animation = '';
  }

  sizeTicker(true);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(pending);
    pending = requestAnimationFrame(() => sizeTicker(false));
  }, {passive:true});
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(() => sizeTicker(true));
  }
})();
</script></body>
